faq.subtitle: Image search, profitability analysis, negotiation, logistics — here are the answers to the questions we're asked most.
faq.q1: Does image search work with a photo taken at the market?
faq.a1: Yes. A clear photo of the product is enough, even taken on a phone in a local market. Our AI identifies the product on 1688, Taobao, and Alibaba, then returns the 3 best suppliers. Just avoid blurry photos or ones with several different products in frame.
faq.q2: What criteria does the AI use to select the top 3 products?
faq.a2: The algorithm weighs sales volume, number of customer reviews, favorites, the supplier's tenure on the platform, its certification, and its seller rating (with a recommended threshold of 4.0/5). When a data point isn't published by the platform, its weight is redistributed across the other criteria rather than being invented.
faq.q3: Does the profitability analysis include customs fees?
faq.a3: The analysis includes the purchase price, estimated shipping costs to your country, and the recommended resale price. Customs duties vary from 20 to 40% depending on the country and product category: we give you the applicable range for your destination so you can factor it into your calculation.
faq.q4: Can I use your negotiation messages if I don't speak Chinese?
faq.a4: That's exactly the point. Every message is generated in Mandarin, ready to be copy-pasted into Alibaba Trade Manager, WeChat, or the 1688 app, with its French translation right below so you know exactly what you're sending.
faq.q5: What happens if no real data is found for my link?
faq.a5: We never fabricate fake data. If the API can't retrieve the product, the report states it clearly and suggests retrying the search by keyword or by image, which succeed in the vast majority of cases.
faq.q6: How long does a full analysis take?
faq.a6: A standard analysis takes between 15 and 30 seconds. Finding the top 3 products takes a bit longer since each finalist candidate is individually verified with the platform.
